Visitor preserve_html action includes raw HTML in output

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_custom_element(self, ctx, tag_name, html):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return "preserve_html"
    html = "<div><custom-tag>Custom content</custom-tag></div>"
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
